author: Prabal Dangol
review_text: In my attempt, the input fields to enter the OTP don't bring up the keyboard. Tried to copy-paste each digit - because the paste functionality still works - but the app said the token had expired! After ~ 30 seconds!!! Does eSewa not have a Quality Analysis at all? Everyone I talk to seems to have a dozen complaints about the app and the reliability of the transactions it attempts to handle. Do the laws of Nepal not have regulatory standards for financial applications such as eSewa? I guess not
